content: What are the commonly used data types in python in week 2?

In Python, there are several fundamental data types that are commonly used in programming. Two of the most basic and widely used data types are integers (int) and floats, which represent whole numbers and decimal numbers respectively. Additionally, strings (str) are also a crucial data type in Python, as they can hold sequences of characters.

These three data types - int, float, and str - form the building blocks for more complex data structures and are essential to understand when programming with Python.
